item.title: Build 401
item.description: Build 401. Build 401 (0.6.0). Settings → Proxy: Clear Unused keeps the open session's proxy; Clear All asks first, then makes that one again in the background. Clearing only touches PictureFollows' own proxies, never your session or its movie. While a proxy is being made, hover over the menu bar icon for live progress, and Settings → Proxy shows a live bar. Open at login no longer mentions On.

item.title: Build 398
item.description: Build 398. Build 398 (0.5.0). No On switch: while PictureFollows is running, it follows. Bypass steps aside, Quit stops. When you send before a movie's picture is ready, a notice under the menu bar icon shows the progress and time left, and Pro Tools' video plays until then (Pro Tools 2025.06 or later). The picture is used from your next send. Bypass never stops a picture being prepared. The menu shows live progress.

item.title: Build 382
item.description: Build 382. Fixes the black picture in sessions that don't start at 00:00:00:00. Send Log now replaces your session, clip, movie, folder and drive names before anything leaves your Mac. Settings explains each Pro Tools' video playback method.

item.title: Build 369
item.description: Build 369. SpectraLayers: sending the same clips again after clearing the picture, or after closing the tabs, now shows the picture every time.

item.title: Build 364
item.description: Build 364. Pro Tools' video is now marked experimental. Under Settings → Pro Tools' video there's a new Playback choice: Method 1, 2 or 3. If playback looks rough, try another one. Method 1 is the default. The "Pro Tools' video window" setting now saves properly. With "Open it", PictureFollows opens Pro Tools' video window when a send starts and closes it again when you send back.
